title: 12 Stones
textBlocks:
Hello Braverhearts
In today’s Bible story 
you will hear 
what God wants them to build 
to remember what God did

Last week we learnt how GOD STOPPED THE RIVER 
and let all His people cross the river on dry ground. 
Just like He did 40 years earlier at the Red Sea

Now He wants each tribe to take a stone out for the river 
and take it to their camp site and build a memorial.
So that one day their children will ask 
“WHAT DO THESE STONES MEAN?”
then they can tell them about how amazing God is. 
And how He stopped the river so that many many people could cross into the promised land!
Make play dough stones to remember todays lesson

TALK TO JESUS
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for the Bible
Thank you for my mom and dad
Please help me to follow You
Please help me to tell other people how amazing You are.
Amen
